This diagnosis is supported by the typical presentation and developmental pathway of ectopic thyroid tissue. Other considered conditions such as maternal diabetes mellitus, radiation exposure, iodine deficiency, and failed fusion of the palatine shelves with the nasal septum do not align well with the specific presentation and location of the mass in this case.
